entries.title: Pattern Playground Interactive Multi-Variant Engine & Badge Spacing Repair
entries.description: Conducted a comprehensive functional and visual audit of the Pattern Explorer. Replaced static category preview stubs with an advanced pattern-specific simulation engine (PAT_ENGINE) supporting 4 distinct architectural variants and 8 dynamic interaction states for all 125 patterns. Fixed cramped priority and maturity badge pills with comfortable tokenized padding and dimensions. Added realistic mobile (390px) and tablet (768px) device simulations with inline light/dark theme switching and state reset controls.
entries.summary: Major fix overhauling the Pattern Explorer across all 125 UX and AI patterns with dynamic multi-variant and multi-state architecture, repaired badge pill breathing room, and realistic mobile/tablet viewport reflow.
changes: Fixed Priority & Maturity badge pills across list, detail headers, cards, and playground with tokenized padding (padding: 4px 12px, min-height: 24px, border-radius: 999px) eliminating cramped borders and text wrapping.
Engineered PAT_ENGINE delivering genuine structural variants (Standard Card, Compact Inline Embed, Modal Dialog Sheet with dark overlay backdrop, and Full-Page Workspace) across all 125 UX patterns.
Implemented real interactive states (Default, Focused input rings, Loading spinner banners, Success verification alerts, Error corrective alerts, Disabled, Expired, and Empty states).
Overhauled viewport simulation to render dedicated device frames for Mobile (390px) and Tablet (768px) with responsive layout reflow and instant theme switching.
Added interactive playground action controls: Cycle Next State, Cycle Variant, Clear Form Inputs, and Reset Pattern Defaults.
Verified all 125 patterns across all 8 UX/AI categories with 21/21 passing automated tests and zero console errors.
Validated 0 horizontal page overflow across all 9 target responsive viewports (320px-1920px).
entries.commitMessage: fix(patterns): overhaul pattern playground with multi-variant engine, interaction states, and badge spacing

entries.title: Reference-Accurate Homepage Visual Rework & Dedicated Landing Shell
entries.summary: Transformed the Meld homepage into a reference-accurate, full-bleed immersive landing experience with a decoupled two-shell architecture, 3D iridescent monogram prism, and prominent Design & Develop pathways.
entries.description: Redesigned the root homepage to match the visual presence and aesthetic quality of Microsoft Fluent 2, Google Material Design 3, and IBM Carbon. Decoupled the landing experience from the persistent documentation sidebar into an expansive 100vw, ~88vh dark hero with custom 3D acrylic monogram artwork, orbital coordinate ring, 4 glassmorphic satellite micro-UI artifacts (OKLCH token sphere, Micro Data Grid specimen, Space Grotesk specimen, AI Copilot supervision chip), dual Design and Develop entry cards, and asymmetric featured ecosystem showcases.
changes: Implemented decoupled two-shell architecture (body.is-landing vs body.is-doc) giving the homepage a 100vw full-width presentation without sidebar constraints.
Built immersive ~88vh hero stage with ambient radial glows, architectural blueprint grid backdrop, and oversized Space Grotesk headline.
Crafted floating 3D acrylic monogram prism ('M') with orbital ring and 4 glassmorphic satellite UI artifacts.
Created prominent tactile Design & Develop pathway cards with glowing glass borders and technology stack badges.
Implemented asymmetric featured ecosystem showcases for 100+ Components Suite, 125 UX & Agentic AI patterns, and multi-device standard.
Integrated editorial 5-core Design Principles spread and 5-column full-width site index footer.
Verified 0 horizontal page overflow across all 9 target viewports (320px-1920px) and seamless bidirectional hash navigation to internal documentation sections.
entries.commitMessage: feat(homepage): reference-accurate visual rework and dedicated landing shell

entries.title: Homepage, Landing Experience & Complete Design System Navigation Portal
entries.summary: Introduced a dedicated homepage, modular blueprint composition, full information architecture with category accordions, and global ⌘K search.
entries.description: Transformed Meld by IDEO into a complete design system portal inspired by IBM Carbon, Google Material Design 3, and Microsoft Fluent 2. Added root landing experience at /, tailored entry points for designers and developers, five architectural pillars, featured resources, editorial design principles, global Cmd+K search modal, and expandable sidebar navigation.
changes: Created dedicated Homepage at / featuring hero typography, key metrics, and an interactive modular blueprint visual canvas.
Added dual quick entry points for Designers (Figma kits, Space Grotesk, OKLCH scales) and Developers (semantic tokens, APIs, WCAG 2.2 touch targets).
Implemented Global Search modal (Cmd/Ctrl + K) with instant typeahead across Foundations, Components, Patterns, Guidelines, and Resources.
Enhanced left navigation with collapsible category accordions, active scroll synchronization, and mobile slide-out drawer.
Integrated editorial Design Principles section, Get Started guide, About portal, and comprehensive 5-column global footer.
Preserved 100% of existing Typography, Colors, Components (100+), and Patterns (125) with zero horizontal overflow across 9 viewports.
entries.commitMessage: feat(portal): introduce homepage, complete navigation architecture, and global search

entries.title: Updated Behaviours for Multi-Device Responsiveness
entries.summary: Full responsive audit, layout repair, and mobile/tablet standardisation across all 9 target viewports (320px - 1920px).
entries.description: Resolved all root-cause layout overflow and mobile clipping defects across Overview, Typography, Colors, Components, Patterns, and Changelog modules. Established unified responsive standards with fluid container clamping, mobile navigation drawer ergonomics, single-column preview reflow, and WCAG 2.2 AA target size compliance.
changes: Audited and verified 0 horizontal overflow across all 9 target viewports from 320px small mobile to 1920px wide desktop.
Repaired global header overflow by adding responsive breakpoint rules, compact logo handling, and hiding oversized taglines on mobile.
Standardised fluid section padding clamp(28px, 5vw, 64px) clamp(16px, 4vw, 40px) and flexible container constraints (.in).
Refactored component and pattern explorer previews to automatically stack to single-column on screens <= 768px with full width containment.
Enclosed category architecture tables and data grids in touch-friendly horizontal scroll containers (.tb) preventing container blowout.
Updated touch target sizes to minimum 40px for mobile buttons, drawer navigation links, and interactive controls matching WCAG 2.2 AA.
entries.commitMessage: feat(responsive): updated behaviours for multi device responsiveness

entries.title: Repair Complex Data Components & Interaction Lifecycle
entries.summary: Repaired behaviour, state lifecycles, and visual representations for Column Visibility Menu, Editable Cell, Filter Builder, and Data Grid.
entries.description: Resolved root-cause generic table fallback by implementing dedicated component controllers, type-aware query builders, in-place cell editing state machines, and a unified Phase 3 integrated scenario workflow.
changes: Implemented dedicated Column Visibility Menu with real-time column search, locked identifier protection, and live grid synchronization.
Implemented Editable Cell with complete lifecycle (View, Hover, Focus, Edit, Dirty, Saving, Saved, Validation Error) across 5 data types.
Implemented Filter Builder featuring type-aware operators, dynamic value inputs (between, enum, text), and AND/OR logic conjunctions.
Implemented Data Grid composite architecture with sorting, row selection, bulk actions, density switcher, pagination, and a 7-step integrated workflow scenario.
Added WCAG 2.2 AA compliant token bindings and side-by-side light and dark preview modes.
entries.commitMessage: fix(components): repair behaviour, states, and integration for complex data components

entries.title: Changelog Page & Update Tracking System
entries.summary: Introduced a dedicated, editorial changelog page and permanent change-tracking architecture.
entries.description: Established an evolving record of all design system updates with multi-facet filtering, summary metrics, and strict contributor guidelines for ongoing traceability.
changes: Introduced dedicated Changelog page and timeline interface integrated into main navigation.
Added multi-facet filtering by category (Features, Improvements, Fixes, Breaking, Docs), search, and version.
Added dynamic summary overview metrics calculated from single source of truth changelog.json.
Created CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md defining mandatory pre-commit changelog workflow.
Dual data-loading architecture supporting HTTP fetch and standalone offline file:/// execution.
entries.commitMessage: feat: introduce changelog page and update tracking

entries.title: Initial Meld Design System Release
entries.summary: Initial baseline release of Meld Design System by IDEO.
entries.description: Comprehensive design system containing typography, color tokens, 18 repaired core components, and 125 UX patterns across 8 categories with AI workflows.
changes: Introduced Space Grotesk typography system with primitive and semantic tokens.
Introduced WCAG 2.2 AA color tokens, OKLCH tonal scales, and dual light/dark themes.
Implemented and repaired 18 core UI components with full interactive states and Figma references.
Introduced 125 UX design patterns with interactive workflows including AI Content Generation and Human-in-the-Loop Approval.
Added global search, token copy utilities, and interactive preview sandbox.
